debug.title: Debug & Diagnostics
debug.subtitle: Enable verbose diagnostic logs for troubleshooting integration issues.
debug.notice_info: Debug logging produces detailed execution traces. All sensitive credentials, tokens, and GPS coordinates are masked automatically in accordance with security guidelines.
debug.enable_desc: Record verbose operational logs for API requests and device filtering.

home_config.title: Widget Configuration
home_config.subtitle: Configure the 4 devices for the 2x2 quick action widget (Tile) on Wear OS. Customize the primary action and display name for each device. If none are selected, the widget falls back to your first 4 Favorites.

guide.title: User Guide
guide.subtitle: Information about app architecture, initial pairing setup, and system requirements.
guide.companion_title: Wear OS by Google Companion App
guide.companion_desc: This Homey application acts as a companion for the standalone Homey app installed on your Wear OS smartwatch. It securely connects your smart home to your watch, synchronizes your 2x2 widget preferences, and enables fast control of devices and automations directly from your wrist.
guide.store_desc: The Wear OS app is currently available in Beta (internal testing). You can join the testing track and install the app directly from Google Play:
guide.login_step1_title: Launch Homey on your smartwatch (same Wi-Fi)
guide.login_step1_desc: Ensure your smartwatch is connected to the same Wi-Fi network as Homey. When launching the app, your Homey Pro will be discovered automatically and its Homey ID will be detected. If automatic discovery is not available, you can enter the Homey ID manually.
guide.login_step2_desc: Select the discovered hub or confirm the manually entered ID, then tap Connect to initiate pairing.
guide.login_step3_desc: The authentication process automatically transfers to your smartphone. Sign in with your Athom account and approve access (a backup QR code is also available on the watch if needed).
guide.login_step4_desc: Once finished on your phone, the smartwatch finalizes pairing within seconds and automatically loads all your smart home devices, favorites, and widgets.
guide.platform_alert: This application is natively designed for smartwatches running Wear OS 3+ (Google Pixel Watch, Samsung Galaxy Watch, etc.) and operates independently on the wrist.
